findings.claim: The learning window and observed score times span [0.0, 0.5] with 50 score nodes at 0.01 spacing; the objective is final predicted target affinity primary, validity and strain secondary, coordinate control only.

Across the 20 landmark soft-mass features, whole-window z magnitudes are small (all |z| < 0.7) while first/last rate z values are large and frequently opposite in sign, indicating strong within-window rate contrasts rather than a stationary whole-window level shift.

No landmark soft-mass feature has an accepted polynomial representation (polynomial_accepted=false for all 20), and all report multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, so no monotone or low-degree temporal trend is supported for these coordinates.
Extrapolation is disallowed for every reported continuous trend row, so no coordinate forecast beyond the observed [0.0, 0.5] window is supported.

hypotheses.direction: time-varying contrast; no absolute coordinate target implied
hypotheses.falsifier: A feature with accepted polynomial representation and consistent first/last rate sign across independent batches would contradict the reversal pattern.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_XX_soft_mass first_rate_z vs last_rate_z sign contrast
hypotheses.scope: global across the 20 landmark soft-mass features over the observed window [0.0, 0.5]
hypotheses.statement: Landmark soft-mass coordinates show large early-window rate contrasts that reverse by the late window, consistent with a time-varying contrast rather than a fixed coordinate target.

limitations: Temporal profiles are not available (temporal_profiles_available=false); only continuous trend summaries were queried.
Only soft-mass landmark features were examined; local covariance and displacement features were not queried.
No decoded final affinity labels are present; selection preference is association evidence, not descendant survival or measured final benefit.
The registered dose recipes (W1/W2/W3) are predeclared interventions, not discovered stage boundaries; no outcome data are available to judge them.
